scripts.dev: tuistory -- sigillo run -c dev -- vite dev
scripts.db:migrate:preview: echo "D1 pre-migration timestamp: $(date +%s)" && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:prod: echo "D1 pre-migration timestamp: $(date +%s)" && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: pnpm db:migrate:preview && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview sigillo run -c preview --mount /tmp/os-secrets.env --mount-format env --command 'tsc && vite build && wrangler deploy --env preview --secrets-file /tmp/os-secrets.env'
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm db:migrate:prod && sigillo run -c prod --mount /tmp/os-secrets.env --mount-format env --command 'tsc && vite build && wrangler deploy --secrets-file /tmp/os-secrets.env'
